name: local-ai-gateway
description: 面向 OpenClaw 的本地 AI 网关与 Electron 控制台
author: Henery002

scripts.clean: find apps packages -type d -name dist -prune -exec rm -rf {} +
scripts.dev:desktop: npm run build && npm run generate:icons && electron apps/desktop/dist/main.js
scripts.dist:desktop: npm run build && npm run generate:icons && node scripts/run-electron-builder.mjs
scripts.package:desktop: npm run build && npm run generate:icons && node scripts/run-electron-builder.mjs --dir
scripts.package:desktop:ready: npm run preflight:release && npm run package:desktop && npm run release:manifest
scripts.dist:desktop:ready: npm run preflight:release && npm run dist:desktop && npm run release:manifest
scripts.preflight:release: npm run check:runtime-deps && npm run build && npm test && npm run smoke:gateway && npm run smoke:desktop-package
